meta.source: Resident interviews compiled by Vital City, provided directly (not public)
meta.note: Quotes are matched to a resident's neighborhood and shown on its primary community district. Only quotes touching a tracked disorder strand are shown; purely crime/violence quotes are not.

quotes.text: I see way too many homeless encampments in nice areas, like my neighborhood. That's the thing that is the most nerve-wracking.
